Owner decision 2026-10-23: option (c) now (consumer survey and bundle checks), with an axis-ownership ADR later as the durable core fix.
Survey of main sources (helper agent; the two POSSIBLE sites verified by reading, link = permits, not yet run):
- POSSIBLE, fails open: align/temporalsupport.scala ~144-160 TemporalSupport.locate. The owner is found by bundle identity, then playbackOn(coordinate.axis.id) with no check that owner == coordinate's bundle or composes that axis by a declared TrackComposition. With Selection.Part(F1), B2's borrowed-axis intervals would read as F1 support; temporalquery, grid, inspection and projection inherit this.
- POSSIBLE, fails open: align/mappingsource.scala ~209 and ~276 SourceRepresentation.of. axisRoles maps anchor axis -> role by axis id alone, so B2 support on F1's axis gets Part(F1).
- Mostly closed: temporalsupport occurrenceEvidence (requires the identical TrackComposition identity).
- SAFE, by construction or by bundle filter: temporalquery region checks (full PresentationAxis equality includes bundle), captionevidence, captionscoring, bridge views, core projection helpers (one support), corpus-intake, codec decoders, story validate, media, view, embed-bench, pipeline; document guarded at 9252b8129.
- External data: no production path builds a borrowed-axis bundle. SourceStream.of is called only by core helpers (each on its own axis); the only SourceBundle.of outside core is SherlockSourceAtlas (a declared composition); codec does not decode bundles. Severity: low today, latent and open-failing for programmatic callers.
Proposed fix slice (align): in locate and in SourceRepresentation.of, require the owner to be the coordinate's or axis's own bundle, or the declared composed bundle with a TrackComposition from that axis; witness each with a borrowed-axis fixture plus the legitimate composed-on-part control. Then the ADR.
